must_mention_risks.text: SNS subscription filter policies must be re-expressed as Pub/Sub subscription filters, whose syntax differs
EventBridge event patterns have no direct Cloud equivalent; routing must be approximated with Pub/Sub topics and filters or Cloud Scheduler
Queue and topic resource policies granting cross-service access must be rewritten as IAM bindings
The Node.js code uses the AWS SDK (v2) and must be rewritten for Google Cloud client libraries
SNS-to-SQS fan-out becomes a Pub/Sub topic with multiple subscriptions
